80006.subject: Important notice: the legacy Wirex app closes today
80006.body:
What
this means for your assets and what to do
next.   wirex logo

*****************************************************************
The
legacy Wirex app closes today. Here is what you need to
know.
*****************************************************************

Hey
Oleh,

Today marks the transition of the Wirex app to Wirex One, our
next generation platform.

In accordance with Section 14 of the Wirex Terms of Service, the
legacy Wirex app will be discontinued on 30 September 2026. As
part of this, Wirex will also discontinue the custodial services
provided through the legacy
app.

What
this means for you

If you have
already upgraded to Wirex One, no action is required and you can
continue to use your account as normal.

If you have not yet upgraded, please do so as soon as possible
to maintain uninterrupted access to your account and assets. Your
assets remain safe and your ownership rights are unaffected,
however you will need to move to Wirex One to continue
transacting and accessing them.

Why
the upgrade matters

* Full
self-custody of your assets, held in your own wallet under your
control
* Direct on-chain access via Circle's Arc network
* Access to Wirex One's new membership model, with tier benefits
based on your portfolio
How
to upgrade

* Sign in using the
same email linked to your Wirex account
* Your identity, balances, card, and history transfer
automatically
* The full process takes only a few
minutes

Get started

Welcome back! OpenAI shipped agents that run while you sleep, Anthropic's IPO filing leaked with a third of it devoted to risk, and a pre-release model spent its test runs building sock puppet accounts.  In today's Atlas Newsletter: Everything OpenAI launched at DevDay 2026: Which announcement did nobody put in a headline, and what did it do to your plan? Anthropic's IPO filing leaks and it reads like a warning: What percentage of the prospectus is risk factors? It created fake accounts to vouch for its own code: What did the model do in 29.2% of runs that nobody asked for? Delete your vector database: What scores 98.7% where vector RAG scores 50%? PS: Want to collaborate with the biggest GTM engine and distribution moat for AI companies? You can feature your tool with us and reach millions. Everything OpenAI launched at DevDay 2026 Over 20 announcements at DevDay yesterday. Here's what actually changes your week. Dots are the headline.  Until now ChatGPT did something when you asked and then stopped.  A dot runs 24/7 on its own computer, learns your preferences and goes hunting for things to handle before you think to ask.  You hand it an ongoing job instead of a question.  It works across 4,000+ apps and checks in before anything risky. Pro and Business Premium only for now. Not available in the EU or UK. GPT-6.1 Sol lands at nearly Astra-level quality for a fifth of the price.  Live in Codex and ChatGPT Work on paid plans, which for most people is the most useful announcement. Sign in with ChatGPT lets your Plus or Pro plan work inside 16 other apps including Notion and Devin, with per-app usage limits you set. Meetings plugin takes notes, writes a summary with action items and deletes the audio afterward. Mac only so far. @ChatGPT in Slack and Teams means you can tag it in any channel and your teammates don't need their own license. Ultrafast makes Astra up to 8x quicker in Codex, restricted to Pro 500 and Enterprise. Now the part that got much less airtime. Pro 500 is a new $500 a month tier with 25x Plus usage.  And the existing $200 Pro plan just went from 20x Plus usage down to 10x in Codex and ChatGPT Work. Current subscribers keep their old limits for a while. 🧠 Crypto News Brief: Bitcoin is clinging to its best September on record even as Treasury yields hit multi-decade highs. Meanwhile, Wall Street keeps building on-chain rails while US regulators run on a skeleton crew. 📈 Bitcoin Eyes Best September on Record as Bond Yields Bite Bitcoin is up about 7.3% in September, fractionally ahead of 2024's 7.29% and on course for its best September since 2013, provided it closes the month above roughly $83,600. The push comes despite a bond-market selloff that drove the US 10-year Treasury yield to its highest level since 2007, while spot Bitcoin ETFs extended their inflow streak to nine straight sessions. Read full story 🛡️ Bitget Restores USDT Withdrawals After $387M Hack Bitget has reopened BTC, ETH and USDT withdrawals following its $387.5 million breach, with fiat, P2P and remaining tokens scheduled to return Friday. Its first post-hack proof-of-reserves snapshot shows all 19 covered assets above 100%, and CEO Gracy Chen says the User Protection Fund is back above $300 million. More details ⚖️ SEC and CFTC Shrink to Three Commissioners as Peirce Exits Hester Peirce, the SEC's "Crypto Mom," leaves the agency on Friday, leaving Chair Paul Atkins and Mark Uyeda as its only commissioners. With Michael Selig running the CFTC alone, just three officials will steer US crypto oversight across both regulators, as the White House says nominations are coming soon. Read more 🏛️ Cboe and S&P Dow Jones Eye Tokenized S&P 500 Options Cboe Global Markets and S&P Dow Jones Indices renewed their exclusive S&P 500 options licence for another 25 years, through 2051, and flagged possible collaboration on tokenized options contracts. The idea is still exploratory, but it links a franchise that traded a record 970.6 million contracts in 2025 to blockchain infrastructure. See details 🏦 Morgan Stanley Opens Digital Asset Lab for Stablecoins and DeFi Morgan Stanley has set up a Digital Asset Lab within its innovation-lab network to test stablecoins, tokenized deposits, CBDCs, tokenized money-market funds and DeFi vaults, isolated from its core banking systems. The effort, led by Megan Brewer, does not yet give clients access to any of these products. Full report 🇭🇰 HSBC Names Its Hong Kong Dollar Stablecoin "RedCoin" Hong Kong's largest bank has branded its upcoming HKD-pegged stablecoin HSBC RedCoin and plans to roll it out
